title: Polynomial work bound for the learner
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and suppose a binary decision tree with real outputs computes its real-valued sign representation and has at most $s$ leaves. Let $0<\varepsilon\leq 1/2$, and consider any outcome in the support of the specified Kushilevitz–Mansour learner run with this parameter and size bound $\max\{1,\lceil 4s^2/\varepsilon\rceil\}$. If $W$ is the local work recorded in that outcome, then $W\leq 2^{66}(n+1)^3(s+1)^{16}/\varepsilon^{18}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is sign-valued on the sign cube
A real-valued binary decision tree computes the real-valued sign representation of $f$
The tree has at most $s$ leaves
The outcome belongs to the support of the specified learner's output distribution
caveat: The formal statement specifies the learning program through many definitions not described informally in the payload; the learner is identified by name and its explicit size parameter.
